name: Crayon Shin-chan Spin-off
description: Unlike the main television anime series which is mostly set in modern-day Japan, the new series will be a "sealed room" suspense comedy set 100 years in the future. The story begins when Shinnosuke and the entire Nohara family wake up from cold sleep to find themselves aboard a space ship drifting in space. The anime will depict the various events that take place inside the ship.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: 10 people and a dog wake up in an unfamiliar spaceship. Why are they here? Nobody knows. Then they hear an eerie roar. What's going on? What will become of the Nohara family?

videos.title: Passengers
videos.overview: 100 years had passed while Shinnosuke and the others were hibernating. When they introduce themselves, they discover that the mall's parking lot is the last memory they all have. They cooperate to locate a small ship to get back to Earth.

videos.title: Who Did It
videos.overview: The small ship Shinnosuke and Ellen find suddenly explodes. Who blew it up and what for? Was the culprit one of them? Meanwhile, Hiroshi stumbles upon a mysterious door.

videos.title: True Identity
videos.overview: Hiroshi brings back a bottle of an 100-year-old Soda Gold. Shinnosuke attempts to drink some out of hunger. Then they find a pillar of sweet jelly-like food. However, when they tentatively try to eat some...

videos.title: Food
videos.overview: "Mr. Smith" was actually Jiro Jailbreaker, a fugitive sentenced to 800 years in prison. He takes control of all the food. As Takosuke butters up to Jailbreaker and gets some, Hiroshi begs to get a small share for his family. Meanwhile, Ellen notices something about the capsules they woke up in.

videos.title: 10 People And A Dog
videos.overview: Micchi and Yoshirin disappear. Shinnosuke and a few others search for them and find something else. They find out there's one less capsule than the number of humans on board. No human could live for a 100 years without being stored in one. Could there be an alien among them?

videos.title: Proof Of Being Human
videos.overview: Shiro suddenly grows bigger and Jailbreaker suspects that the dog is actually the alien. Hiroshi suggests a way to determine whether someone is human or not. As they take turns taking the test, Shiro changes even further.

videos.title: Escape From Prison
videos.overview: Everyone becomes paranoid. Jailbreaker sits before the food with his laser gun in hand. But people become hungry even under such tense circumstances. The situation takes a sudden turn when Shinnosuke mentions the Chocobi snack he saw in a closed-off room.

videos.title: Mealtime
videos.overview: The middle-aged woman among them was actually a robot! She captures Shinnosuke and the others and confines them, but Jailbreaker leads the way and they make a break for it. Then Ellen goes to retrieve James, where she finds…

videos.title: Tonsil
videos.overview: An alien called "Buttman" finally appears before them. The people were brought on board as Buttman's food. Buttman attacks, but they manage to escape to the food storage room. There, the robot takes Himawari as hostage and tells them the surprising truth.

videos.title: Butts
videos.overview: A "tonsil" robot emerges from the woman-shaped shell. They make the tonsil robot tell them the way to return to Earth. The detonator is activated and the mother ship begins to explode everywhere as they hurry to the cockpit. Led by the tonsil robot, they pass through a chamber where they encounter...

videos.title: Buttmen Vs Shinnosuke
videos.overview: Attacked by Buttmen, they break up and run in different directions. Shinnosuke pulls away from Hiroshi to save Shiro. His parents try to stop him but they are separated from the others by a fire shutter. Meanwhile, Jailbreaker and Takosuke arrive at the cockpit first. Will they decide to take off without the others?

videos.title: To Earth
videos.overview: Shinnosuke and Buttman face off. The silliest 5-year-old on Earth and the perfect life form from space clash in a fierce battle of butts. Who will come out victorious? And will Shinnosuke and the others be able to make it back to Earth?

videos.title: Chindarake
videos.overview: A new toy store called "Chindarake" opens in Kasukabe City. Hearing about the Grand Opening, free toy giveaway, children rush to the store and the turnout is great. But little did they know that the toys discarded by humans were plotting their revenge.

videos.title: Action Mask Gold
videos.overview: Shinnosuke and children all over Kasukabe love their shiny new toys. Shinnosuke has all but forgotten about his old Action Mask and Kantam Robot action figures. Then one night, the toys set in motion their plan for revenge, called the "World Toyfication Project."

videos.title: Dada (Tantrum)
videos.overview: All the toys in Kasukabe City go missing. Shinnosuke and the other children begin to throw temper tantrums, begging their parents to buy new toys for them. But Bo chan walks calmly through the city filled with whining kids, with a rock in one hand and something else in the other...

videos.title: Obaan
videos.overview: Obaan dances on a stage and sings, "Toys deserve liberty! Humans deserve revenge!" The toys in the audience cheer her on. Shinnosuke and the other members of the Kasukabe Guard realize that strange things have been happening since Chindarake opened.

videos.title: Run
videos.overview: Shinnosuke's family is transformed into toys! The parents of the Kasukabe Guard members have also changed into toys. Then, Action Mask appears before them. Will Shinnosuke and his friends be turned into toys as well?

videos.title: Middle Aged Mask
videos.overview: Shinnosuke's family is transformed into toys! The parents of the Kasukabe Guard members have also changed into toys. Then, Action Mask appears before them. Will Shinnosuke and his friends be turned into toys as well?

videos.title: To Chindarake On A Train
videos.overview: To find out how to beat Obaan, the Kasukabe Guard members watch the final episode of the TV series called "Goodbye Obaan" but the DVD has been rented out. The Kasukabe Guard and Middle-aged Mask head to Chindarake to defeat Obaan, although they don't know how just yet. Will they be able to get there without being caught?

videos.title: Vs Expentables
videos.overview: The Kasukabe Guard members manage to get to Chindarake. At first they think that beating the toys will be easy since they are bigger, but the security system in Chindarake activates and they are separated from each other. Shinnosuke and Middle-aged Mask face Dr. Garigari. What does he intend to do with them?

videos.title: The Secret Date
videos.overview: The Kasukabe Guard members manage to get to Chindarake. At first they think that beating the toys will be easy since they are bigger, but the security system in Chindarake activates and they are separated from each other. Shinnosuke and Middle-aged Mask face Dr. Garigari. What does he intend to do with them?

videos.title: Seal
videos.overview: The Kasukabe Guard must beat Obaan quickly before the "Dada Energy" collected from the whining children reaches the maximum limit. The members each win the games against their own toys and are reunited. Kazama is the last to appear, and brings a certain "agreement" for them.

videos.title: Action Mask Vs Shinnosuke
videos.overview: Shinnosuke and Middle-aged Mask finally make it to Obaan's room, but Action Mask stands in their way. Realizing that Obaan has become more powerful than he remembered and also having to take on Action Mask as well, Middle-aged Mask resorts to a surprising move.

videos.title: Goodbye Obaan
videos.overview: Action Mask comes to his senses and joins forces with Shinnosuke and Middle-aged Mask to fight Obaan. Action Mask battles it out against the powerful supervillain while Middle-aged Mask urges Shinnosuke to try to remember the last episode of "Goodbye Obaan". Will the heroes be able to defeat Obaan?

videos.title: The Final Episode
videos.overview: At long last, the Dada Energy is filled and the toy weapon Way Ward rises. Will the human world all be transformed into toys? What will happen to Shinnosuke, the Kasukabe Guard members, and Kasukabe City?

videos.title: Butt Swordplay
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke Nohara, master of Nohara style butt swordplay, travels with his family to spread his technique of swordsmanship. People call him the "Lone Wolf and Family."

videos.title: Hazumi
videos.overview: Hazumi witnesses the power of butt swordplay and hires Hiroshinosuke as her bodyguard. The Noharas begin traveling to Mt. Fuji Prefecture with her, but encounter trouble when they try to cross a river on a boat.

videos.title: Work
videos.overview: It becomes apparent that Hazumi's life is in danger. Black Funkycow is using his men to try and kill her. The next assassin is a sniper who has never missed his target before.

videos.title: The Zillion Dollar Woman
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke sees a wanted poster for Hazumi putting a price on her head. He and his wife Omisa become blinded by greed from the prospect of a zillion-dollar reward. They try to get to Mt. Fuji Prefecture as soon as they can.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Right before they arrive in Mt. Fuji Prefecture, a big gorilla appears before them along a mountain pass. It was also sent to capture Hazumi. Black Funkycow apparently works for another man who wants to eliminate her.

videos.title: Mt Fuji Prefecture
videos.overview: Right before they arrive in Mt. Fuji Prefecture, a big gorilla appears before them along a mountain pass. It was also sent to capture Hazumi. Black Funkycow apparently works for another man who wants to eliminate her.

videos.title: True Identity
videos.overview: Hazumi turns out to be the princess of Mt. Fuji Prefecture! She is reunited with her childhood friend Hachibe, who informs her of what her uncle and current lord, Stopper, has been up to. She resolves to go meet with him, but because she is a wanted person, it is too dangerous outside.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke and Omisa's intention of turning Hazumi in for the zillion-dollar reward is outed, and Hachibe locks the Noharas up. Hazumi and her supporters decide to wait for Lord Stopper to pass by outside the castle and confront him. A grand procession arrives.

videos.title: Armpit Swordplay
videos.overview: Hazumi finally confronts Lord Stopper, but is misunderstood as being after his life. Hiroshinosuke comes to her rescue, and fights one-on-one with Black Funkycow. Can his butt swordplay defeat Funkycow's armpit swordplay?

videos.title: Training
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke suffers a crushing defeat against Black Funkycow's armpit swordplay. In order to improve his skill, he must train inside a cave known as the Butt Hole, where numerous swordsmen before him is said to have trained. Will he be able to make it back alive?

videos.title: To The Castle
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke and Shinnosuke finish training and return, only to discover that Hachibe had been captured and will be executed for treason. Will they be able to rescue him?

videos.title: Secret
videos.overview: Hiroshinosuke and Shinnosuke join Omisa and Hazumi inside the castle and attempt to rescue Hachibe. They pass through a secret room with plenty of flowing water. The water in the prefecture's village has dried up. Why is there so much water in the castle?

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Stopper had blocked all the water in Mt. Fuji Prefecture! Hiroshinosuke and Shinnosuke have a final showdown with the evil lord. Will peace and water be restored to the prefecture? What fate awaits the Nohara family?

videos.title: I'm Here O-O-O-No Shinnosuke
videos.overview: A strange monster-related incident occurs in a rural town! A monster born from the grudge of unwanted hair attacks Fumie Sakura, a girl who lives there. Then a monster boy, O-O-O-No Shinnosuke, and his father, Daddy Little Balls, come to the rescue. They are looking for the family's mother. This was the beginning of the epic case of the monster-related problems that would ravage the town.

videos.title: Go Monsters Busters
videos.overview: Fumie takes the monster father and son back home with her. Shinnosuke senses a strong monster vibe and they head to the source. They discover that the monster is not Shinnosuke's mother but a cleaning monster that uses extreme measures to declutter. Fumie, Shinnosuke and his father are tasked with getting rid of the monster at the desperate family's request.

videos.title: At School Monster In The Classroom
videos.overview: Fumie convinces Shinnosuke and his father to form Monster Busters with her to tackle the monster-related problems cropping up around town. She tries to advertise the service to her friends at school but everyone is more interested in lunch, which happens to be curry that day. But a monster that makes everything super spicy appears and makes their curry inedible. It's a job for Monster Busters!

videos.title: Hot Spring Party People
videos.overview: Monster Busters is hired to take care of a monster infestation at a normally tranquil hot spring inn in the mountain. They arrive to find that the cause of the commotion isn't monsters but a bunch of partying people, to Fumie's chagrin. But a monster flower emerges from inside the hot spring, and its pollen turns Shinnosuke and his father into party monsters.

videos.title: Rain Is The Serenade For Strays
videos.overview: One day, Fumie sees a single tattered monster glove walking soaking wet in the rain. She presumes that it has lost its owner and feels sorry for it. She takes it home, names it Chocolat, and tries to attend to its needs. It turns out, however, that the monster glove has other, surprising plans that evening.

videos.title: Good Harvest Forest Of Terror
videos.overview: Fumie hears about a camping site where people are going missing, and heads over with Shinnosuke and his dad to investigate. They follow voices coming from deep in the forest and discover a group of people who have been turned into mushrooms by the "Evil Mushroom King". The evil monster catches the Monster Busters by surprise, and they are all turned into mushrooms and truffles.

videos.title: Part 1 Find Mom
videos.overview: While Shinnosuke is relaxing at Fumie's home, he suddenly hears his missing mother Misae's voice calling him from somewhere. Convinced that he will find her at last, he dashes out alone and follows the voice to a deserted hospital. His mother's voice beckons him into the abandoned building, but he soon discovers that a shady monster tamer has lured him into a trap.

videos.title: Part 2 Find Mom
videos.overview: Fumie and Shinnosuke's dad come to his rescue in the nick of time, but Dino the monster tamer unleashes a swarm of demons that make people feel lethargic. They try to shake the demons and escape from Dino, but are far outnumbered and face certain doom. Meanwhile, Misae turns out to be closer than they think.

videos.title: Goodbye And Then
videos.overview: Shinnosuke is finally reunited with his mother and little sister, and they have quality family time for a while. He is no longer interested in fighting other monsters because he has accomplished his goal of finding his missing family and wants to go home. But Fumie wants to stop Dino from causing more trouble, and they end up arguing. Will Monster Busters go their separate ways?

videos.title: Disruption Monster Panic
videos.overview: Monsters suddenly overrun the town and people are thrown into a panic! The residents evacuate to a gymnasium where the Mayor addresses them and declares a state of emergency. He urges everyone to leave the town immediately, but Fumie notices that he appears to be the only one not being attacked by monsters. She follows the Mayor back to his residence and overhears a horrible secret!

videos.title: Most Evil Monster President
videos.overview: The Mayor is the mastermind of the monster incidents in the town! He had hired Dino the monster tamer to chase away the town's residents in order to build a big casino. As the final step of his plan, he tries to release the most evil monster, the Monster President, from the pot where it had been sealed for centuries. Will Shinnosuke and the others be able to stop the Mayor's ambitious scheme?

videos.title: We're Monster Busters
videos.overview: The evil monster released from the pot takes over the Mayor's body and overwhelms the Monster Busters with its incredible power. Struck by the noxious substance the monster Mayor spits out, Shinnosuke's parents forget who they are and are transformed into savage monsters. Then, Shinnosuke is also struck by the substance!

videos.title: Farewell, O-O-O-No Shinnosuke
videos.overview: Fumie's fury brings Shinnosuke and his parents back to their senses, but the Monster President emerges from the Mayor's body and shows its humongous true form. As the evil monster heads towards the town, Fumie and Shinnosuke put forth their final effort to stop it from destroying the world. The final battle between the Monster Busters and the most evil monster begins!
